name: SOUL
summary: National voice/data/broadband carrier (SOUL Pty Ltd, ex-S.P. Telemedia, rebranded 2004, ACN 085 089 970); brand absorbed.

events.details: Acquired by TPG Telecom (TPG Holdings) — merger with TPG announced; effective 22 Apr 2008.

refs.label: SP Telemedia traded as SOUL; merger announced 7 Feb 2008.
ASX announcement confirming SOUL/SP Telemedia absorbed by TPG.
soul.com.au had been repurposed to the Juniper apartment project by Oct 2008; ISP brand moved to soul.net.au.
SOUL ISP-brand site on soul.net.au still live 2019; domain captures end c. 4 Mar 2021.
